Upsert a JobDefinition record into the catalog.

The client computes the `id` as `"{name}@{version}"`; the service
validates the join, the runtime selector, and writes. Re-POSTing
the same `(name, version)` overwrites — that's the intended bundle-
redeploy ergonomic.

get.description:
Return a representative CrewChatEvent so the OpenAPI schema
carries the type and `gen:api` picks it up for typed FE
parsing. Not for live consumption — live events flow over
`/jobs/{id}/logs/stream` and are detected by JSON-parsing each
log line and matching the `event` discriminator.

ArtifactSummary.title: ArtifactSummary
ArtifactSummary.description:
Lightweight row for the artifact list view — enough to render
the index and filter without hydrating every full artifact.

ArtifactTypeRecord.title: ArtifactTypeRecord
ArtifactTypeRecord.description:
Plain-data record for an artifact type.

Keyed `(name, version)` where `name` is the discriminator string
(e.g. "math_question", "ai_answer", "math_conversation") and
version follows the same defaulting story as JobDefinition.

ArtifactTypeSpec.title: ArtifactTypeSpec
ArtifactTypeSpec.description:
One registered artifact type — `BaseArtifact` subclass projected
into a UI-friendly registry entry. Drives the `/artifact-types`
viewer.

BatchArtifactRequest.title: BatchArtifactRequest
BatchArtifactRequest.description:
Body for `POST /artifacts/batch` — hydrate many artifacts in one
round-trip (replaces a `GET /artifacts/{id}` per id). Fails loud:
any missing id 404s the whole batch, matching `get_many`.

CodePackageRecord.title: CodePackageRecord
CodePackageRecord.description:
Metadata pointer to an installable code blob.

`blob_id` is the FileRepository logical name (filename within the
`code_packages` prefix) — fetching the bytes goes through the
file repository, not this record.

ConversationTurn.title: ConversationTurn
ConversationTurn.description:
A single agent move in the conversation.

Embedded in `MathConversationArtifact.turns` and mirrored on
`MathConversationState.turns` while the run is in flight. `latex`
and `figure` are inline — the math-ui `<Latex>` component and figure
renderer take these values directly.

CrewChatEvent.title: CrewChatEvent
CrewChatEvent.description:
One event in the live conversation stream.

Mirrors `docs/math_conversation.md` → Live visibility. Optional
fields are populated per event kind (e.g. `content` on `message`,
`tool_name` on `tool_call`).

note_date.title: Note Date
note_date.description: The study day this note belongs to.

ocr_text.title: Ocr Text
ocr_text.description: Combined text/LaTeX parsed from the note's photos.

DailyNoteArtifact.title: DailyNoteArtifact
DailyNoteArtifact.description:
One captured study note, tied to a calendar day.

`storage_ref` / `content_type` / `byte_size` are inherited from
`BaseArtifact` and point at the uploaded **audio** blob. `transcript`
is populated by the ingest job's transcription node. `image_refs`
holds the notebook photos captured with the note; `ocr_text` is the
combined text/LaTeX parsed from them by `ParsePagesStep`, with the
per-photo structured detail (LaTeX, concepts, diagrams) living in the
sibling `NotePageArtifact`s.

spec.title: Spec
spec.description: The validated semantic figure spec — opaque JSON.

FigureArtifact.title: FigureArtifact
FigureArtifact.description:
Validated semantic figure spec (Munkres / Lee / Tu style).

Produced by `RenderFigureStep` after the agent has converged on
a structurally valid spec via the `validate_figure` tool. The
`spec` is an opaque JSON payload — the FEATURES.md plan calls
for keeping it as `dict[str, Any]` server-side; the renderer
contract lives in `math-ui`. `template` is duplicated out of the
spec for indexable filtering.

GateSpec-Input.title: GateSpec
GateSpec-Input.description:
A single human-review gate carried by a JobDefinition.

`review_schema` is the pydantic `model_json_schema()` of the review
body — the API uses it to validate `POST /jobs/{id}/review` once the
catalog drives routing. For now it's recorded for completeness.

JobDefinitionRecord-Input.title: JobDefinitionRecord
JobDefinitionRecord-Input.description:
Plain-data record of a job's control plane.

Keyed `(name, version)`. The id is the derived `"{name}@{version}"`
string; downstream callers reference it by `id` (versioned) or by
`name` (latest) depending on the path.

JobDefinitionRecord-Output.title: JobDefinitionRecord
JobDefinitionRecord-Output.description:
Plain-data record of a job's control plane.

Keyed `(name, version)`. The id is the derived `"{name}@{version}"`
string; downstream callers reference it by `id` (versioned) or by
`name` (latest) depending on the path.

LatexAnswerArtifact.title: LatexAnswerArtifact
LatexAnswerArtifact.description:
Validated LaTeX rendering of an AI answer.

Produced by `GenerateLatexStep` after the agent has converged on
KaTeX-compilable source via the `validate_latex` tool. `is_valid`
is always True at persistence time — invalid drafts never escape
the validation loop. `validation_attempts` records how many
rounds of tool feedback the agent took to converge.

LogEntry.title: LogEntry
LogEntry.description: Single log record emitted by the worker for one job.

MathConversationArtifact.title: MathConversationArtifact
MathConversationArtifact.description:
The whole brainstorm transcript, persisted once at end-of-run.

`seed_question` is the question the panel explored — pulled from a
source `math_qa` job's artifacts or wrapped from fresh input text.
`source_job_id` records provenance when seeded from a prior job.

source_job_id.title: Source Job Id
source_job_id.description: Seed from a completed math_qa job's artifacts.

question_text.title: Question Text
question_text.description: Fresh question to brainstorm (when not seeding from a job).

MathConversationInput.title: MathConversationInput
MathConversationInput.description:
Typed submit input — a variant of the platform request union.

Exactly one of `source_job_id` (seed from a completed `math_qa` job)
or `question_text` (fresh question) must be set; the validator
rejects "both" and "neither" at the API boundary.

MathConversationResult.title: MathConversationResult
MathConversationResult.description:
Typed result — a variant of the platform result union.

The single `conversation` artifact is resolved from `artifact_refs`
by the result endpoint's hydrator.

audio_ref.title: Audio Ref
audio_ref.description: storage_ref of the uploaded voice note (POST /media).

image_refs.title: Image Refs
image_refs.description: Optional notebook-photo storage_refs captured with the note.

MathNotesInput.title: MathNotesInput
MathNotesInput.description:
Submit input for a `math_notes` ingest job.

`audio_ref` is the voice note to transcribe (a `storage_ref` from the
`POST /media` response); `image_refs` are optional notebook photos
captured alongside it. `note_date` defaults to today (resolved in the
graph node) when omitted.

MathNotesResult.title: MathNotesResult
MathNotesResult.description: Typed result for a `math_notes` job — the minted note, by ref.

MathQAInput.title: MathQAInput
MathQAInput.description: Typed submit input for a Math Q&A job — variant of the platform request union.

MathQAResult.title: MathQAResult
MathQAResult.description:
Typed result for a Math Q&A job — variant of the platform result union.

Each typed field is an artifact resolved from `artifact_refs` (defined
on `BaseJobResult`). The result endpoint hydrates them via the
workspace artifact store.

MediaRef.title: MediaRef
MediaRef.description:
Handle for an uploaded blob — what `POST /media` returns and what
a domain stamps onto a `storage_ref`-backed `BaseArtifact`.

note_date.title: Note Date
note_date.description: The study day this page belongs to.

latex.title: Latex
latex.description: Math on the page, transcribed as LaTeX.

diagram_description.title: Diagram Description
diagram_description.description: Description of any diagram/figure on the page.

NotePageArtifact.title: NotePageArtifact
NotePageArtifact.description:
A parsed notebook page — the vision interpretation of one photo.

Minted per `image_ref` alongside the parent `DailyNoteArtifact`.
`storage_ref` points at the photo (so `GET /artifacts/{id}` hydrates a
viewable `storage_url`); `source_note_id` links back to the note. The
structured fields (`latex`, `concepts`, …) are produced by the domain
from the platform's *generic* `ImageInterpreter` text — the
math-specific interpretation lives here, domain-side, per §13.

RootModel_Annotated_Union_MathNotesInput.title: RootModel[Annotated[Union[MathNotesInput, MathQAInput, MathConversationInput], FieldInfo(annotation=NoneType, required=True, discriminator='job_type')]]

ToolCallRecord.title: ToolCallRecord
ToolCallRecord.description: One tool invocation an agent made inside a turn.

is_correct.title: Is Correct
is_correct.description: Did the user mark the answer correct?

UserComment.title: UserComment
UserComment.description: User feedback on an AI response.

WorkflowListItem.title: WorkflowListItem
WorkflowListItem.description: Lightweight registry entry — drives the platform-level workflow index.

ai_platform__jobs__workflow_schemas__Gat.title: GateSpec
ai_platform__jobs__workflow_schemas__Gat.description:
Execution-policy gate — declares that after `node_name` runs,
a human review of `review_type` must be submitted before the
workflow continues.

ai_platform__workspace__storage__structu.title: GateSpec
ai_platform__workspace__storage__structu.description:
A single human-review gate carried by a JobDefinition.

`review_schema` is the pydantic `model_json_schema()` of the review
body — the API uses it to validate `POST /jobs/{id}/review` once the
catalog drives routing. For now it's recorded for completeness.
